name: USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions
description: Event study: How does USD/JPY move after BOJ rate decisions (hikes, cuts, and holds)? Detects BOJ policy actions via Japan call money/interbank rate (FRED IRSTCI01JPM156N). Classifies each monthly observation as hike (>=5 bps), cut (<=-5 bps), or hold (<5 bps abs change). Splits post-decision USD/JPY paths by VIX regime (High Vol VIX>=18 vs Low Vol VIX<18). Includes spaghetti chart of 20-day USD/JPY paths labeled by decision type + VIX regime, median return bars by horizon for all 3 decision types, and summary stats table.
source:
# USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions
# Detects BOJ hikes, cuts, and holds via Japan call money rate (FRED monthly)
# Splits post-decision USD/JPY paths by VIX regime (>=18 vs <18)
# Measures forward returns at +1d, +5d, +20d for hikes, cuts, and holds

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# Japan call money / interbank rate (monthly, sparse on daily bars)
jp_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
rate_raw = jp_rate_raw.result
rate_filled = ffill(rate_raw)

# VIX daily via FRED VIXCLS
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

# --- Detect BOJ Rate Decisions ---
# New monthly observation arrives
had_new_obs = is_valid(rate_raw)

# Previous observation value
prev_rate = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_new_obs, rate_raw)

# Rate change in bps (guard: both must be valid)
rate_change_bps = where(is_valid(rate_raw) and is_valid(prev_rate), (rate_raw - prev_rate) * 100)

# Classify decision type
is_hike = is_valid(rate_change_bps) and rate_change_bps >= 5
is_cut = is_valid(rate_change_bps) and rate_change_bps <= -5
is_hold = is_valid(rate_change_bps) and rate_change_bps > -5 and rate_change_bps < 5

# Any decision (unified trigger for path tracking)
is_any_decision = is_hike or is_cut or is_hold

# --- Forward Returns on USDJPY ---
fwd_1d = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# Hike forward returns
hike_fwd_1d = where(is_hike, fwd_1d)
hike_fwd_5d = where(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_fwd_20d = where(is_hike, fwd_20d)

# Cut forward returns
cut_fwd_1d = where(is_cut, fwd_1d)
cut_fwd_5d = where(is_cut, fwd_5d)
cut_fwd_20d = where(is_cut, fwd_20d)

# Hold forward returns
hold_fwd_1d = where(is_hold, fwd_1d)
hold_fwd_5d = where(is_hold, fwd_5d)
hold_fwd_20d = where(is_hold, fwd_20d)

# All decisions (for summary table)
all_fwd_1d = where(is_any_decision, fwd_1d)
all_fwd_5d = where(is_any_decision, fwd_5d)
all_fwd_20d = where(is_any_decision, fwd_20d)

# --- Post-Decision Price Paths (spaghetti chart) ---
# Days since last decision of any type
days_since_decision = barssince()(is_any_decision)

# Only bars within 0-20 day window after a decision
in_window = is_valid(days_since_decision) and days_since_decision >= 0 and days_since_decision <= 20

# Close price on the decision day
decision_close = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_any_decision, close)

# Cumulative return since decision (indexed to 0% at day 0)
cum_ret_path = (close - decision_close) / decision_close

# VIX level on the decision day
vix_at_decision = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_any_decision, vix)

# Vol regime classification: High Vol (VIX >= 18) vs Low Vol (VIX < 18)
is_high_vol = is_valid(vix_at_decision) and vix_at_decision >= 18

# Decision type labels (carry forward from last decision)
# Use valuewhen to capture which type the last decision was
hike_flag = 1.0 if is_hike else 0.0
cut_flag = 1.0 if is_cut else 0.0
hold_flag = 1.0 if is_hold else 0.0

last_was_hike = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_any_decision, hike_flag)
last_was_cut = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_any_decision, cut_flag)
last_was_hold = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_any_decision, hold_flag)

# Build combined label: Decision Type | VIX Regime
label_hike_hv = "Hike | High Vol" if (is_valid(last_was_hike) and last_was_hike > 0.5 and is_high_vol) else ""
label_hike_lv = "Hike | Low Vol" if (is_valid(last_was_hike) and last_was_hike > 0.5 and not is_high_vol) else ""
label_cut_hv = "Cut | High Vol" if (is_valid(last_was_cut) and last_was_cut > 0.5 and is_high_vol) else ""
label_cut_lv = "Cut | Low Vol" if (is_valid(last_was_cut) and last_was_cut > 0.5 and not is_high_vol) else ""
label_hold_hv = "Hold | High Vol" if (is_valid(last_was_hold) and last_was_hold > 0.5 and is_high_vol) else ""
label_hold_lv = "Hold | Low Vol" if (is_valid(last_was_hold) and last_was_hold > 0.5 and not is_high_vol) else ""

# Combine into single label (only one will be non-empty at a time)
combined_label = conditional_select(
    is_valid(last_was_hike) and last_was_hike > 0.5 and is_high_vol, "Hike | High Vol",
    is_valid(last_was_hike) and last_was_hike > 0.5 and not is_high_vol, "Hike | Low Vol",
    is_valid(last_was_cut) and last_was_cut > 0.5 and is_high_vol, "Cut | High Vol",
    is_valid(last_was_cut) and last_was_cut > 0.5 and not is_high_vol, "Cut | Low Vol",
    is_valid(last_was_hold) and last_was_hold > 0.5 and is_high_vol, "Hold | High Vol",
    is_valid(last_was_hold) and last_was_hold > 0.5 and not is_high_vol, "Hold | Low Vol",
    "Unknown"
)

# Filter to window only
path_ret = where(in_window, cum_ret_path)
path_offset = where(in_window, days_since_decision)
path_label = where(in_window, combined_label)

# --- Event marker data ---
vix_at_event = where(is_any_decision, vix)
rate_at_event = where(is_any_decision, rate_raw)
change_at_event = where(is_any_decision, rate_change_bps)

# Direction label for event markers
direction_label = conditional_select(
    is_hike, "Hike",
    is_cut, "Cut",
    is_hold, "Hold",
    ""
)
direction_at_event = where(is_any_decision, direction_label)

# --- Output 1: SPAGHETTI — USD/JPY Paths by Decision Type + VIX Regime ---
xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY After BOJ Decisions: Paths by Type & VIX Regime',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    y_axis_label='Return from Decision Day',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Trading Days After Decision',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    split_by_label=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Decision Day', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=path_offset, y_values=path_ret, label=path_label)

# --- Output 2: PUNCHLINE — Median Forward Returns by Horizon, Hike vs Cut vs Hold ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median USD/JPY Return: Hike vs Cut vs Hold',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Cut'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Cut'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Cut'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Gray, stack='Hold'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Gray, stack='Hold'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Gray, stack='Hold')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(hike_fwd_1d, hike_fwd_5d, hike_fwd_20d, cut_fwd_1d, cut_fwd_5d, cut_fwd_20d, hold_fwd_1d, hold_fwd_5d, hold_fwd_20d))

# --- Output 3: REFERENCE — Summary Stats Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Decisions — USD/JPY Forward Return Stats (All Types)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['N (Events)', 'Median Return', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['+1 Day', '+5 Day', '+20 Day'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    order=2
)(all_fwd_1d, all_fwd_5d, all_fwd_20d)

# --- Event Markers: BOJ Rate Decisions ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Decision',
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Decision', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Change (bps)', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='New Rate (%)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='+5d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(direction_at_event, change_at_event, rate_at_event, vix_at_event, all_fwd_5d, is_any_decision)
